subject: FY 2022 Operating Budget and ESSER Funding
overview: The School Committee approved the $67.4 million fiscal year 2022 operating budget and endorsed a plan for federal pandemic relief funds. The body also completed the annual performance evaluation of the Superintendent.

items.title: Superintendent Performance Evaluation
items.summary: Approved the 2020-2021 evaluation of Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent, with members praising her leadership during the pandemic and the district's new strategic plan.

items.title: FY 2022 Operating Budget
items.summary: Approved the proposed $67,461,003 operating budget for the 2021-2022 school year, contingent upon final appropriation by the City Council.

items.title: ESSER II and III Funding Priorities
items.summary: Endorsed a series of strategic investments totaling approximately $2.1 million from federal pandemic relief funds to support reading interventionists, social-emotional learning, and summer programming.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation before the Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination and collective bargaining matters.
